entities.name: Alfava Metraxis
entities.description: Non-canon plane from Doctor Who, home planet of the two-headed Aplans, where Weeping Angels caused their extinction.

entities.name: Aplans
entities.description: Extinct two-headed humanoid species of Alfava Metraxis, relaxed, cheerful and prolific builders.

entities.name: Aplan Mortaria
entities.description: Subterranean labyrinths with tombs, also called Mazes of the Dead, with six levels representing the ascent of the soul.

entities.name: Weeping Angels
entities.description: Creatures whose colony came to Alfava Metraxis and hunted the Aplans to extinction.

entities.name: Eleventh Doctor
entities.description: Described the Aplans as a relaxed and cheerful species.

events.summary: In the 47th century a large population of Weeping Angels comes to Alfava Metraxis and collapses Aplan civilization.
events.quote: In the 47th century, a large population of Weeping Angel s came to Alfava Metraxis and quickly caused the collapse of the Aplan civilization.

events.summary: Having hunted the Aplans to extinction, the Angels degrade and hibernate.
events.quote: Having hunted the Aplans to extinction, the Angel colony lacked any energy source

relations.quote: Having hunted the Aplans to extinction
